title: Pleading a civil claim
summary: A pleading states a party’s claims or responses in the form required by the applicable procedural rules. A complaint must provide a sufficient account of entitlement to relief to move the case forward.
notes: An allegation accepted as true on a motion to dismiss is not thereby established as fact for trial or summary judgment.

sections.Meaning: A pleading states a party’s claims or responses in the form required by the applicable procedural rules. A complaint must provide a sufficient account of entitlement to relief to move the case forward.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the rule and court system. State the relevant conduct, actors, injury, and basis for relief in intelligible factual terms. Apply Rule 8 plausibility to the claim, then any special particularity requirements. Distinguish those requirements from what evidence must eventually prove.
